integrity: The exact general radial eigenvalue formula is prior art; the proposed claim is the adjacent-gap factorization, complete simultaneous pronic resonances and slope ratio. Numerical verification supplements but does not substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only consecutive Hermite-index eigenvalue equalities for the normalized second-Hermite window and centered disks; no classification of nonconsecutive coincidences, global spectral ranks, other windows or noncircular regions. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Pronic double triple resonances in second-Hermite disk localization
